sentences.text: Sally Margaret Field -LRB- born November 6 , 1946 -RRB- is an American actress and director .	Margaret Field	Margaret Field

Field began her career on television , starring on the sitcoms Gidget -LRB- 1965 -- 66 -RRB- , The Flying Nun -LRB- 1967 -- 70 -RRB- , and The Girl with Something Extra -LRB- 1973 -- 74 -RRB- .	Gidget	Gidget (TV series)	The Flying Nun	The Flying Nun	The Girl with Something Extra	The Girl with Something Extra

She ventured into movies with Smokey and the Bandit -LRB- 1977 -RRB- and later Norma Rae -LRB- 1979 -RRB- , for which she received the Academy Award for Best Actress .	Smokey and the Bandit	Smokey and the Bandit	Norma Rae	Norma Rae	Academy Award for Best Actress	Academy Award for Best Actress

She later received Golden Globe Award nominations for her performances in Absence of Malice -LRB- 1981 -RRB- and Kiss Me Goodbye -LRB- 1982 -RRB- , before receiving her second Academy Award for Best Actress for Places in the Heart -LRB- 1984 -RRB- .	Academy Award for Best Actress	Academy Award for Best Actress	Absence of Malice	Absence of Malice	Kiss Me Goodbye	Kiss Me Goodbye (film)	Places in the Heart	Places in the Heart

Field received further nominations for a Golden Globe Award for Best Actress for Murphy 's Romance -LRB- 1985 -RRB- and Steel Magnolias -LRB- 1989 -RRB- .	Golden Globe Award for Best Actress	Golden Globe Award for Best Actress – Motion Picture Musical or Comedy	Steel Magnolias	Steel Magnolias

In the 1990s , Field appeared in a wide range of films , including Not Without My Daughter -LRB- 1991 -RRB- and Mrs. Doubtfire -LRB- 1993 -RRB- , before being nominated for the BAFTA Award for Best Actress in a Supporting Role for Forrest Gump -LRB- 1994 -RRB- . In the 2000s , she returned to television with a recurring role on the NBC medical drama ER , for which she won the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Guest Actress in a Drama Series in 2001 . From 2006 to 2011 , she portrayed the lead role of Nora Walker on the ABC television drama Brothers & Sisters , for which she received the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Lead Actress in a Drama Series in 2007 .
